pulses.name: CVE-2026-39987 update: How attackers weaponized marimo to deploy a blockchain botnet via HuggingFace

pulses.name: A Slopoly start to AI-enhanced ransomware attacks
pulses.description: IBM X-Force discovered a likely AI-generated malware named 'Slopoly' used in a ransomware attack by the Hive0163 group. This marks the beginning of AI adoption among cybercrime groups, potentially transforming the threat landscape.
